notes.title: REVIVAL OF LAST DAYS!!!
notes.notes:
That's right! Now that I've completed Pembrey, I am willing to completely remake this project bigger, better, and COMPLETELY. But obviously I can't do this without the help of you guys! I will be making the "sequel" to this game, Last Days: Necrosis and I'm hoping that you all can help me with it! I've made a kickstarter page with much more detail on what the game is going to be about so even if you don't want to donate, you can still see what I have planned!

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/realcgg/last-days-necrosis

I hope that you guys want to see this project go live, because I'd love for this game to be complete PROPERLY this time. I've learned a lot after working on Pembrey and I'm ready to make this my most ambitious project to date so you guys can enjoy the thrilling zombie, base-building, choice driven, survival, RPG game that you all deserve! And with that, I leave you with this thumbnail. Cheers!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26581328/7617bd622cc4f67c6593f0e928cb1cd51b4e9677.png[/img]

notes.title: Free to Play, forever.
notes.notes: There is no point in making you guys pay for a game that can never be completed. For any of you who purchased the game, I'm so terribly sorry and I hope that I can somehow make up for it in later projects.

notes.title: The game is done for...
notes.notes: I have some very unfortunate news for you all. While gettting the Steam SDK files to transfer into my game, they decided to overwrite my .dll files in the game's API. What does that mean? That means the game cannot be worked on, updated, or even played... My last stable backup was a few months ago and the previous backups are unplayable. So basically what I'm saying is the game is now complete. It will never be worked on again and I will be working on different projects now. Thank you all for the support during the development, this has been the best year of my life, and I hope you all will look forward to more games that I will be developing in the future.

notes.title: Approaching Release
notes.notes: Good news, runners! The game is nearing completion and the full and final game may be released sometime this week or next week. It's been a stressful, [i]and[/i] fun 9 months but the game is nearing it's end. These are the Last Days of development. Thank you for all the support you guys have given me during this development cycle. I hope that you all will look forward to the other games I will be releasing in these following months.

notes.title: Patreon Page
notes.notes: You don't need to donate if you don't want [b]BUT[/b] if you want to get your name in the credits and contribute towards the game's development, please [url=https://www.patreon.com/user?u=4955003]click here[/url] to become a Patreon. Any and all money is appreciated and you get special rewards too!

notes.title: Permanent Price Change $1.99
notes.notes: I'm very sorry for the people that bought this game for full price originally. I really am. Due to decreasing popularity, I am setting the final price for the game as $1.99.

notes.title: Update 0.0.12? Where are you?
notes.notes: I'll tell you where it is. Still in progress. I've been adding a whole new area that has taken up about a month of my time. I could have it released within the next 2 weeks or so but I really want to pay attention to the detail of the game. Every day, I'm learning new things about the direction this game is going in. Please be patient! I'm going to work this out. Thanks!

notes.title: Update 0.0.12 Soon
notes.notes: I've been working pretty frequently on the game now and I'm excited to introduce a few new things I've added. I do not wish to say what they are because it is much better if kept a secret but I am very certain you'll like what I have in store. The update is planned for tomorrow but could be later depending on how much more I need to add. Thank you for following the development of "Last Days".
